messages:
reena (sales): Short follow-up from AH Q&A: customers flagged three repeat reasons we lost deals. Can leadership confirm the top themes so Sales can update playbooks?

sam (ceo): High-level: (1) pilot lead time, (2) lack of a named technical POC, (3) perf guarantees at scale. Pricing rarely the reason.

anya (product): Noted. Concrete asks we should deliver: a 1-page 'why we lose/win' cheat sheet, a pilot fast-path checklist + named-POC SLA, and a short quantization tradeoffs note for demos.

reena (sales): Sales wants a 30s elevator script and a template pilot timeline (week-by-week) they can paste into emails. Also need clear language we can put in quotes (pilot SLA snippet).

eli (cs): CS will own the named-POC process and draft the SLA snippet. I'll produce a pilot handoff checklist and a sample onboarding email. ETA: 4 business days.

dave (eng): For perf we can offer a 'pilot perf-run' (load test + perf dashboard) that we run with customers. I'll produce the script and a short runbook. ETA: 5 days.

maya (eng-infra): I'll create a minimal pilot image + Terraform template to speed onboarding. If we scope minimally, ETA: 7 business days.

anya (product): Product will write the cheat sheet + 30s elevator copy and a 2-page quantization FAQ. Target: 2 sprints for the FAQ, cheat sheet this week.

sam (ceo): Good. Ops-bot, please schedule a 30-min follow-up next Tue to lock owners and deadlines.

ops-bot: Calendar invite "Signal debrief: playbooks & pilots" Tue 11:00  attendees: Sam, Anya, Reena, Eli, Dave, Maya.

reena (sales): I'll post 6 prospect notes in #sales-playbooks ahead of the sync so we can prioritize who to target first.

eli (cs): After the sync CS will publish the SLA snippet and checklist to the playbooks folder and ping #customer-success.

anya (product): Thanks everyone. Please drop any customer quotes here so Research can pull examples into the playbook. We'll track progress in the follow-up invite.
_meta: generated for dataset: all-hands Q&A about customer wins/losses and feedback loops
